organization.zh: 壞主意有限公司｜猿創立兒童程式營隊

description.zh:
猿創立提供兒童程式設計營隊，透過 Minecraft、Python 與 APCS 相關課程，讓學生在操作與任務中接觸程式設計。

擔任營隊助教，協助學生理解題目、操作程式與完成學習任務，依不同年齡和學習進度提供協助。
description.en:
Coding Ape offers children’s programming camps involving Minecraft, Python, and APCS-related learning through hands-on activities and tasks.

As a teaching assistant, I helped students understand questions, work with programs, and complete learning tasks, adapting support to different ages and learning progress.

description.zh:
粘巴達假日學校的竹北樹屋遊戲空間於 2011 年建立，以傳統遊戲、戶外活動與動手搭建，讓孩子在玩樂中探索與合作。

我從 2019 年開始擔任兒童營隊助教，陪伴不同年齡的孩子完成團隊任務，與他們一起生火煮飯、玩大地遊戲與蓋樹屋。這些相處與帶領的經驗，讓我發現自己喜歡與孩子一起學習、探索。
description.en:
Nianbada Childhood School’s Treetopia play space was established in Zhubei in 2011. It offers traditional games, outdoor activities, and hands-on building so children can explore and cooperate through play.

I began assisting at its children’s camps in 2019. I helped mixed-age groups complete team tasks and joined them in making fires, cooking, outdoor games, and building treehouses. Working with them helped me discover how much I enjoy learning and exploring alongside children.

description.zh: 參與人本基金會的兒童營隊，在戶外活動與團隊任務中陪伴學生探索、合作及完成挑戰。擔任活動員，協助活動執行與學生陪伴，累積帶領兒童與處理現場需求的經驗。
description.en: Participated in children’s camps with the Humanistic Education Foundation, supporting exploration, cooperation, and challenges through outdoor activities and group tasks. As an activity staff member, I supported camp delivery and accompanied students, developing experience in working with children and responding to on-site needs.

description.zh: 參與教會的兒童陪讀服務，透過閱讀陪伴與互動，協助孩子投入學習，累積與兒童溝通及觀察不同學習需求的經驗。
description.en: Volunteered in church-based children’s reading activities, using reading support and interaction to help children engage with learning while developing communication skills and awareness of different learning needs.
